scoring_justification: Recompute of the stochastic KMC simulation is infeasible within the verifier sandbox; we instead compare the resulting histograms and best-fit coefficient to digitized gold distributions and the known optimal D2D value from the paper, using monotonic error-based scoring for histograms and exact-match tolerance for D2D.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference step-size distributions for homogeneous PS and PS-hexagonal surfaces, digitized from the paper's Figure 3 simulation curves at D2D=0.20 μm²/s.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Figure 3 of the source paper (ACS Macro Lett. 2016, 5, 603–608, DOI: 10.1021/acsmacrolett.6b00183). The curves correspond to the KMC simulation results for the homogeneous PS and PS-hexagonal surfaces under the optimal parameters described in the text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization of the published figure using WebPlotDigitizer; the extracted points were corrected for axis ranges and then resampled to a common grid.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values represent the quantified simulation output that the paper reports as reproducing the experimental data; they are the only publicly available numeric reference for the expected shape of the simulated step-size distributions.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing D2D in μm²/s.

outputs.description: Optimal in-plane diffusion coefficient selected by the agent.
Simulated step-size histogram for the homogeneous PS surface, used to verify the model's reproduction of the experimental in-plane diffusion mode.
Simulated step-size histogram for the PS-hexagonal surface, used to verify the model's reproduction of the flight-dominated transport without in-plane diffusion.

output_contract.notes: The experimental step-size distributions are provided for calibration only; the graded histograms must be generated by the agent's own KMC simulation. The hidden gold references are digitized from the paper's Figure 3 simulation curves for the same conditions.

steps.note: The paper reports D2D = 0.20 μm²/s with an acceptable range of 0.18–0.22 μm²/s. Exact match within tolerance awards full credit; otherwise zero.
Score = max(0, 1 - mean_relative_error / 0.30). A perfect match yields 1.0; mean relative error ≥ 0.30 yields 0.
Score = max(0, 1 - mean_relative_error / 0.30). A perfect match yields 1.0.
